findings.claim: H&S 17920.3 defines a substandard building by listed conditions that exist to an extent that endangers life, limb, health, property, safety or welfare; library print supports the wording.
H&S 17920.3(a)(12), (a)(16), (h) and (j) name who decides or what condition counts, each with its alternative deciders and thresholds carried in the claim.
Civ. Code 1102(a) and (c) and 1102.6(a) are supported only as quoted; 1102.2 exceptions, the form's content and any statement about what a hoarder-house seller must disclose are NOT in the library.
Whether California law mentions hoarding, and any city or county rule, could not be verified from the stored prints.

required_actions: Ask Leo for an official leginfo print of Civil Code 1102.2 (exceptions to the disclosure requirement) before any article says who is exempt from the Transfer Disclosure Statement.

Ask Leo for an official print of Civil Code 1102.3 and the published text of Stats. 2020 Ch. 370 Sec. 25 (the Real Estate Transfer Disclosure Statement form, pp. 34-38) before any article says what the form asks the seller to disclose; the 1102.6 print is marked incomplete text.

Ask Leo for an official print of the local (city or county) housing, nuisance or code enforcement ordinance for any place the article names; until then the article says exactly: local rules vary; check with your city or county.

Do not write that California law mentions or does not mention hoarding without a statute_absence claim; the 17920.3 print is stored but no absence proof was prepared (it would need a full read, term search, section and date). Ask Leo whether to prepare it.
Professional-confirmation note required in the article for every legal claim here: a real estate attorney or the local enforcing agency should confirm how these rules apply to a specific property.

claims.text: Under California Health & Safety Code 17920.3, a building or part of one (including a dwelling unit or the premises it is on), regardless of zoning or approved uses, is declared a substandard building when any of the listed conditions exists to an extent that endangers the life, limb, health, property, safety, or welfare of the occupants, nearby residents, or the public.
claims.quote: Any building or portion thereof, regardless of zoning designation or approved uses of the building, including any dwelling unit, guestroom or suite of rooms, or the premises on which the same is located, in which there exists any of the following listed conditions to an extent that endangers the life, limb, health, property, safety, or welfare of the occupants of the building, nearby residents, or the public shall be deemed and hereby is declared to be a substandard building:

verification.label: MATCH
verification.reason: Claim restates the threshold, scope and consequence in the quoted text.

gates.text: to an extent that endangers the life, limb, health, property, safety, or welfare of the occupants of the building, nearby residents, or the public
regardless of zoning designation or approved uses; includes dwelling units and the premises

claims.text: Under H&S 17920.3(a)(12), infestation of insects, vermin, or rodents counts as inadequate sanitation when determined by a health officer or, if no agreement exists with an agency that has a health officer, by a code enforcement officer (as defined in Penal Code 829.5) who has completed a course of study in the subject as determined by the local jurisdiction; as with every listed condition, it makes a building substandard only to an extent that endangers life, limb, health, property, safety, or welfare (see clm:1).
claims.quote: (12) Infestation of insects, vermin, or rodents as determined by a health officer or, if an agreement does not exist with an agency that has a health officer, the infestation can be determined by a code enforcement officer, as defined in Section 829.5 of the Penal Code, upon successful completion of a course of study in the appropriate subject matter as determined by the local jurisdiction.

verification.label: MATCH
verification.reason: Claim carries both deciders and the training condition; the endangerment threshold is stated in the claim and in clm:1.

gates.text: health officer, or a code enforcement officer where no agreement exists with an agency that has a health officer
to an extent that endangers life, limb, health, property, safety, or welfare

claims.text: Under H&S 17920.3(a)(16), lack of adequate garbage and rubbish storage and removal facilities counts as inadequate sanitation when determined by a health officer or, if no agreement exists with an agency that has a health officer, by a code enforcement officer as defined in Penal Code 829.5; it makes a building substandard only to the endangerment extent in clm:1.
claims.quote: (16) Lack of adequate garbage and rubbish storage and removal facilities, as determined by a health officer or, if an agreement does not exist with an agency that has a health officer, the lack of adequate garbage and rubbish removal facilities can be determined by a code enforcement officer as defined in Section 829.5 of the Penal Code.

verification.label: MATCH
verification.reason: Claim names both deciders and the condition as worded; quote runs across two consecutive passages.

gates.text: health officer, or a code enforcement officer where no agreement exists with an agency that has a health officer
to an extent that endangers life, limb, health, property, safety, or welfare

claims.text: Under H&S 17920.3(j), premises on which an accumulation of weeds, vegetation, junk, dead organic matter, debris, garbage, offal, rodent harborages, stagnant water, combustible materials, and similar materials or conditions constitute fire, health, or safety hazards are a listed condition; the building is a substandard building only to the endangerment extent in clm:1.
claims.quote: (j) Those premises on which an accumulation of weeds, vegetation, junk, dead organic matter, debris, garbage, offal, rodent harborages, stagnant water, combustible materials, and similar materials or conditions constitute fire, health, or safety hazards.

verification.label: MATCH
verification.reason: Claim lists the same materials and hazard test; the section does not use the word hoarding and the claim does not say it does.

gates.text: conditions must constitute fire, health, or safety hazards, and exist to an extent that endangers life, limb, health, property, safety, or welfare

claims.text: Under H&S 17920.3(h), any building or part of one, device, apparatus, equipment, combustible waste, or vegetation that, in the opinion of the fire chief or the chief's deputy, is in such a condition as to cause a fire or explosion or provide a ready fuel to augment the spread and intensity of fire or explosion from any cause is a listed condition; the building is substandard only to the endangerment extent in clm:1.
claims.quote: (h) Any building or portion thereof, device, apparatus, equipment, combustible waste, or vegetation that, in the opinion of the chief of the fire department or the chief's deputy, is in such a condition as to cause a fire or explosion or provide a ready fuel to augment the spread and intensity of fire or explosion arising from any cause.

verification.label: MATCH
verification.reason: Claim names the decider (fire chief or deputy) and the test.

gates.text: the chief of the fire department or the chief's deputy decides, in their opinion
to an extent that endangers life, limb, health, property, safety, or welfare
